summary: Flippo holds an AIPAC endorsement and, on Real America's Voice in July 2025, blamed Hamas for Gaza's humanitarian crisis, saying the group had "proven what they are." In October 2026 he touted post–October 7 aid to Israel, claiming his nonprofit delivered food, although records attribute the delivery to the Order of St. John. His platform states no specific Israel or Palestine policy.
